channel.description: Weekly Disney Lorcana tournament results, news and community highlights.

item.title: Hyperia City hits shelves: Emerald-Steel leads early Core meta while Amber-Amethyst takes Heroes Ink
item.description: Hyperia City (Set 14) went on sale at all retailers on October 23, a week after its October 16 prerelease. Players report it is easy to find at or under MSRP. • The first Hyperia City Core Constructed meta report puts Emerald-Steel Evasive on top at about 23% of the field. Amber-Emerald Circle is next at about 15%, followed by Amber-Sapphire Princesses. • TT_Egelim won Heroes Ink 'Chapter 14 - Page 1' in Germany (36 players) with Amber-Amethyst. Amber-Emerald Songs won Top Deck Keep the same weekend. • Ravensburger confirmed Collector Boosters and a new serialized Illustrious rarity for Into the Inkdark on February 12, 2027. They will only be sold through Play Hub stores, Ravensburger's online store and some Disney locations. • The Quest World Iconic Clash, a Top 16 invitational and one of the first high-level Set 14 events, is releasing its Round 1 matches on JDZ Quest's channel.

item.title: Hyperia City hits shelves, first Set 14 invitational goes to EdLorcana, and Inkdark Collector Boosters get details
item.description: Set 14, Hyperia City, went on general sale October 23 after prereleases that started October 16. It adds Coco and the new ink drop mechanic, and the release notes change how stacked keywords work and issue errata for Jukebox. • Edmond Chiu (EdLorcana) won the 16-player Quest World Iconic Clash invitational on October 17, the first big look at Set 14 decks. His list was titled "Emerald / Steel", and several of the broadcast matches were Emerald/Steel. • Into the Inkdark (Set 15) preorders are open for a reported February 12, 2027 release. It brings 12-card all-foil Collector Boosters and the serialized Illustrious rarity (23 copies of each card). Collector Boosters will be sold only at select Play Hub stores and Disney locations. • Flash is the first card people are calling broken in the new format. Manifest TCG calls it a new Steel staple, and Reddit says it's overtuned at 2 cost.
